product_intent: A compact desktop device for manually advancing an internal platform in discrete steps through rotation of an external crank while maintaining position between steps

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop indexing box
The user should rotate an external hand crank to advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step
The output should remain stationary between indexing events
The mechanism should be enclosed inside a protective housing
The number of indexed positions is not prescribed
The product should be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, practical to manufacture, and suitable for repeated manual operation

requirements.statement: The product must enable a user to rotate an external hand crank to advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step

verification.observable: Internal indexing platform advances by one discrete step when external hand crank is rotated
verification.condition: External hand crank is rotated by user

requirements.statement: The product must maintain the internal indexing platform in a stationary position between indexing events

verification.observable: Internal indexing platform remains stationary between indexing events

requirements.statement: The product must be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, practical to manufacture, and suitable for repeated manual operation

verification.reason: Requirements related to assembly, manufacturability, and repeated operation cannot be verified without physical testing or detailed engineering analysis

requirements.statement: The product must enclose all internal mechanisms inside a protective housing

verification.observable: All internal mechanisms are contained within protective housing

requirements.statement: The product must be compact and desktop-sized

verification.observable: Product dimensions fit within desktop-sized workspace

requirements.statement: The product must operate through manual operation only

verification.observable: Product operates without any electrical or power source
